newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: GTE awarded $100 mln in CANTV issue.
newsitem.headline: GTE awarded $100 mln in CANTV issue.

text.p: GTE Corp was only awarded $100 million of the $200 million worth of shares it offered to buy in last week's global share issue of Venezuela's national telephone company CANTV, a top government official said.

"They tried to buy $200 million, but they were only assigned $100 million by the investment bank," Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) President Alberto Poletto told reporters after a hearing in Congress.
Before Thursday's issue, GTE Corp owned 51 percent of the VenWorld consortium which purchased a controlling 40 percent stake in CANTV in 1991.
Poletto added the CANTV global issue, in which the government sold most of its remaining 49 percent in the company, raised $1.16 billion.
